Prepare step by step

  1. For an active emergency or immediate danger, call 911 and follow responsible official instructions.
  2. Identify communication, medication, mobility, pet, transportation and backup-power needs privately.
  3. Use official alert, emergency-information and weather routes; do not rely on a cached plan for live conditions.
  4. Choose meeting points and contacts, keep supplies current and review the plan after household or workplace changes.

General preparedness help only—not emergency monitoring, dispatch, evacuation orders, weather warnings, safety certification or a substitute for official live instructions.

Before you contact or choose a service.

  • Confirm current requirements, hours, eligibility, credentials, service area, accessibility, availability and total cost directly.
  • Keep names, narratives, account details, medical identifiers, child information and document text off this public page.
  • Directory appearance, order and paid status are not rankings, referrals, endorsements or proof of fit.
  • You choose whether to copy, print or share this plan; Franklin Navigator does not send it.
